background: Wells Fargo & Company is the holding company of one of the four largest US banks, with consumer banking and lending, commercial banking, corporate and investment banking and wealth management, and a long regulatory remediation behind it.
synthesis: All three agencies rate the group, A on average and the weakest of them at BBB+, two on a stable outlook and one on positive, though the last move was a one-notch upgrade by one of the three as long ago as 12 Jul 2021. Capital is the weak point: CET1 of 10.3% is in the bottom quarter of US banks and has fallen 0.9 points since 30 Jun 2025, with leverage down the same 0.9 points to 5.8%, which still leaves it at the peer median. Liquidity is the better side, LCR of 119% above the median and broadly flat over the same span, on figures to 30 Jun 2026. Both capital measures moving one way over a year is the thing to follow here; nothing bearing on credit stands out in what has been flagged in the last 90 days, the most recent item dated 24 Sep 2026.
